context: Researchers measure the concentration of a drug in the blood, x, at times t minutes after it is given. The scatter diagram has t on the horizontal axis and x on the vertical axis, and the least squares regression line of x on t is found.
task: Explain what is meant by the "least squares" regression line of x on t.

elements.label: Sum of squares of residuals
elements.scheme: the line for which the sum of the squares of the residuals

elements.label: That sum is minimised
elements.scheme: is a minimum

elements.label: Distances in the x-direction (vertical)
elements.scheme: where the residuals are the distances from the points to the line measured in the x-direction (vertically on this diagram)

model_answer:
It is the line for which the sum of the squares of the residuals is a minimum,
where each residual is the distance from a data point to the line measured in the $x$-direction (the concentration), i.e. vertically on this diagram.

tests.pass: It is the line where the sum of the squares of the vertical distances (in the x-direction) from the points to the line is minimised.
tests.fail: It is the line where the sum of the squares of the horizontal distances from the points to the line is minimised.
